view.name: Invoice list
view.description: Table of all invoices with status filter tabs, status badges, totals, payment methods and a Create Invoice button.

regions.label: App top bar: Invio logo and wordmark, nav links Dashboard / Invoices / Customers, and a More dropdown (Products, Settings, Users, Logout)
H1 'Invoices' with a lilac 'Create Invoice' primary button
Rounded panel holding status toggle buttons: All, Sent, Draft, Complete, Paid, Voided
Invoice table with sortable headers (Invoice No ▼, Customer, Total, Status, Issue Date, Paid with, Updated) and about 250 rows with colored status pills

evidence.note: Persistent top bar with global destinations; it scrolls away and is not sticky
A details/summary trigger that, when clicked live, opens a vertical list: Products, Settings, Users, Logout, each with a line icon

evidence.quote: All Sent Draft Complete Paid Voided
evidence.note: Status toggle buttons. In the live page, clicking Sent filtered the table to 5 rows right away; the URL stayed /invoices
Single-select segmented button group. The active option ('All') gets a gray-blue #a8b2c1 fill
The status strip looks like a tab strip, but it narrows one table rather than switching between peer views. Coded as filter-controls.

evidence.quote: Invoice No ▼ Customer Total Status Issue Date Paid with Updated
evidence.note: Header row of sortable column buttons. 'Paid with' cannot be sorted.
Row: the invoice number links to the invoice detail page; status shows as a colored pill
By default the table is sorted by invoice number, descending (newest first). In the live page, clicking Customer re-sorted A→Z and moved the arrow to that header, inside a highlighted pill.
Status pill in each row: Draft (light), Sent (blue #5f95c9), Paid (green #4fbf8c), Complete (yellow-green #c9d92e), Overdue (red #b94b5c), Voided (gray #a8b2c1)
The table ends at INV-2025-001 with no pager. All rows render on one page.
No checkbox column and no selection toolbar

structure.layout: web app with a slim top navigation bar, then a centered 1280px main column: page title and primary action, a status filter strip in a rounded panel, and one very long data table holding every invoice (no pagination, no footer)

aesthetics.typography: Inter is declared everywhere (the rendered glyphs look like a DejaVu-style sans fallback). Navy text throughout. Header labels and buttons are small 11–12px semibold; table cells are 14px regular, and invoice-number links are 14px medium.
aesthetics.typeScale: Restrained: H1 24px/600, wordmark 20px/600, body and table cells 14px/400, filter buttons and the primary button 12px/600, column headers 11px/600 in muted slate-blue, status pills about 12px. Hierarchy comes mostly from weight and color, not size.

notes: Pale lavender-blue page (#eef1f9) with near-white rounded panels (16px radius) for the filter strip and the table. All text is a deep indigo/navy (#202269) instead of black. The primary 'Create Invoice' button is a pastel lilac (#c79bfc) with dark navy text. The selected filter and the active sort header get a gray-blue pill. Status pills are small and fully colored with white text (Draft is a pale chip with navy text). The Updated column is right-aligned in muted slate. Amounts mix currencies (€, $, £). There is no pagination, so about 250 rows render into an almost 12,000px page. The column set changes with the filter: 'Paid with' disappears under the Sent filter. Nav items carry small line icons (Lucide-like). The 'Paid with' header looks inconsistent: it is plain text in larger type than the other, sortable header buttons.
